newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Mines' listings reinstated Friday.
newsitem.headline: Rand Mines' listings reinstated Friday.

text.p: Rand Mines Ltd said on Friday its listings on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and London Stock Exchange, which were suspended on Thursday pending details of a court decision, would be reinstated today.
It said in a paid advertisement South Africa's Supreme Court had dismissed with costs an application for a declaratory order in respect of medical aid contributions.
The liability Rand Mines may incur in respect of these medical aid payments had been estimated at about 35 million rand.
In addition, the counter application againt Rand Mines for payment of almost 1.7 million rand succeeded. No provision has previously been raised by the firm for these liabilities.
Rand Mines' directors were consulting with legal counsel to determine a plan of action and shareholders would be advised of any developments in due course.
